paper_title: Essentially tight bounds for rainbow cycles in proper edge-colourings
summary: Question 10.1 asks whether the $\log\log n$ factor in the average-degree bound of Theorem 1.1 is necessary to guarantee a rainbow cycle in a properly edge-coloured graph. The May 2026 literature review found no follow-up resolving the question.
